verdict.rationale: Choosing where data is stored is a fair question for a cloud payments platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-residency or region-selection option. The local-network vs cloud integration choice (adyen-pos-docs-2) concerns how the POS communicates with terminals, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
